# Matrix verification distinguishes own-user, device and direct-room requests

Current MatrixSession starts requestOwnUserVerification for the current session and requestDeviceVerification(ownerId,deviceId) for another device. Account.startVerificationDM uses own-user verification for self and requestVerificationDM(userId, roomId) for another participant after waiting for its room. Preserve those separate targets and parameter shapes when upgrading the SDK. This does not demonstrate a completed secure verification or device-trust update at runtime. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: chat/protocols/matrix.
